title: Key shapes
description: The kinds of key that a masker replaces with *** wherever they appear, whether or not the run knows the key's value: key-shapes.json, the default list, and a list that adds a deployment's shapes after the default ones. A find is the prefix, then, with blank, 1 to 16 spaces or tabs, then a token of at least min characters of the alphabet, of which it covers at most max. The schema uses only $id, type, properties, items, required, additionalProperties, minItems, minLength, minimum, maximum and pattern, so a small checker in another language reads it the same way. Rules the schema does not state, which Forager's mask.Merge checks: each name once in the list; a name and a prefix of at most 64 characters; max at least min; a max of at most 256 unless blank is true or a byte of the prefix is outside the alphabet; at most 64 shapes; and the alphabet's form, ranges and single characters such as A-Za-z0-9_-, where a - between two characters is the range from the first up to the second and a - at the end is the character - itself.

name.description: The shape's id: lower-case letters and digits in parts that single hyphens join, such as github-token.

prefix.description: The text every key of the shape starts with: printable ASCII without a space, such as ghp_.

any_case.description: True compares the prefix regardless of the case of its ASCII letters.

blank.description: True requires 1 to 16 spaces or tabs between the prefix and the token.

word_start.description: True counts a find only when the prefix starts the text, or the byte before it is not an ASCII letter, digit or `_`, or the prefix follows an escape: `\` and one letter, `\u` and four hex digits, `\x` and two hex digits, or `%` and two hex digits. False, the default when the member is missing, counts a find wherever the prefix is.

alphabet.description: The characters of the token: printable ASCII without a space, as ranges and single characters, such as A-Za-z0-9_-.

min.description: How many characters of the alphabet the token has at least.

max.description: How many characters of the token a find covers at most; the characters after them are scanned again as text.
